metadata.case_name: HU KAI MEI MILDRED v. PANG YUN SHING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: In Gilman her job was only to answer phone calls, filing, order papers, clearing up pantry and photocopy room and sometimes typing (receptionist)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Helped out in her husband’s shop in New Golden Centre and worked full time from 1 p.m. to 8 p.m.

injuries.description: Contusion injuries to her left upper and lower limb.
source: She was diagnosed to have contusion injuries to her left upper and lower limb.

injuries.description: Abrasion and bruising over her left forearm and left leg, swelling over the left index finger, left thigh and knee region.
injuries.body_part: left forearm and left leg (left index finger, left thigh and knee region)
source: On examination she was found to have abrasion and bruising over her left forearm and left leg, swelling over the left index finger, left thigh and knee region.

injuries.description: Nerve contusion of the left anterior inter osseous nerve.
injuries.body_part: left anterior inter osseous nerve (left forearm/hand)
source: In March 2003 a nerve conduction test was performed and was diagnosed to be nerve contusion of the left anterior inter osseous nerve.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of median nerve at forearm level

injuries.description: Slight degree of radial deviation in her left wrist (left wrist staying in the ulnar deviated position and could not perform radial deviation).
source: a slight degree of radial deviation in her left wrist.
the left wrist was staying in the ulnar deviated position and could not perform radial deviation.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of radiocarpal joint

manifestations.description: pain and minor external injuries on the left side of her body
abrasion and bruising over her left forearm and left leg
swelling over the left index finger, left thigh and knee region
she could walk with a stick when she was discharged
weakness in pinch, grip and associate with numbness over left index finger
occasional wrist pain on carrying heavy objects
mild numbness over the tip of her left index finger and to a lesser extent the tip of her left thumb
Deviation of her wrist to ulnar side persisted
Weakness in her ability to bend those 2 digits (flexion) which leads to her tending to drop things like spoons and bowls
frequent nightmares and flashbacks of the accident
intense anxiety and felt on edge most of the time; became irritable and agitated; hyperarousal symptoms triggered by traffic noise
fragmented sleep, early morning wakening, decreased appetite, impaired concentration and poor memory, a sense of worthlessness

treatments_received: physiotherapy and occupational therapy provided till August 2002
psychiatric/psychosomatic clinic assessment and psychiatric treatment in the public sector
treatments_future: Continue treatment at the public sector psychosomatic/psychiatric clinic (monthly visits for another year)

losses.description: mild numbness over the tip of her left index finger and to a lesser extent, the tip of her left thumb with a slight degree of radial deviation in her left wrist. As a result she suffered slightly in her grip when she applied these 2 fingers.
to a minor extent it may affect her emotions.

comparable_cases.case_name: So Chung Kwong v Ng Ming Fong
comparable_cases.injury_description: The Plaintiff a carpenter was struck by motor cycle, broken scaphoid bone in his left hand, minor abrasions, put in plaster, follow up treatment for 12 weeks, therapy for another 6 months, pain and lack of mobility persisted in left wrist, right palm and right ankle, sick leave for 2 years, upon recovery, only minor reduction in his capacity to work. The award under this head was $125,000.
